sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Zucchetti is Italy's largest independent software company serving over 700,000 businesses with ERP, accounting, HR, and payroll solutions. This integration provides access to customers, invoices, and employees.

sections.title: Prerequisites
sections.content: You need a Zucchetti account with API access. Contact Zucchetti or your reseller to enable API credentials.

sections.title: How to Connect
sections.content:
1. Contact your Zucchetti account manager or reseller.
2. Obtain your API token from the Zucchetti administration panel.
3. Enter the Bearer token in the connection form.

sections.title: Available Actions
sections.content:
list-customers: List customers from the Zucchetti CRM/accounting module.
list-invoices: List sales invoices with date filtering.
list-employees: List employees from the Zucchetti HR module.
